subject: Your best MCP servers post
text:
Hi MCP.so team,

I read your best MCP servers post from Oct 15. Labeling each pick local or remote and checking the endpoints against vendor docs is really handy.

I run PickAPlugin, a small hand-sorted directory of ChatGPT and Codex plugins. We put together a report on the Codex plugin side of things (what people are building, how they install, what's maintained): https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

It's free to cite with a link back if it's ever useful for a post on MCP inside Codex. Happy to list any MCP.so projects on our side too.

Thanks,
Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Your October MCP download report
text:
Hi there,

Your October MCP download report on ai101.tools was a good read, especially the rising and falling section. Fetch and Firecrawl both jumping was interesting.

I run PickAPlugin, a hand-sorted directory of ChatGPT and Codex plugins. We wrote up a report on Codex plugins that might pair well with your numbers if you ever cover the plugin side: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

Free to cite with a link back. Glad to return the favor and point to your monthly report from our side.

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Your registry checks + our Codex plugin data
text:

I like what you're doing on ProtocolProbe, especially that the data is free to reuse with dates and sources. That's rare.

I run PickAPlugin, a hand-sorted directory of ChatGPT and Codex plugins, and we did something similar on the Codex plugin side: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

If it's ever useful in one of your reports, it's free to cite with a link. I'd happily link to your MCP server checks from our guides too.

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Your best MCP servers page
text:

subject: Free listing for Mermail on PickAPlugin
text:
Hi,

Read your best MCP servers for AI agents post. The narrowest documented setup column is a great idea, and I appreciated you being upfront that Mermail is yours.

I run PickAPlugin (https://pickaplugin.com), a hand-sorted directory of ChatGPT and Codex plugins. If Mermail has a Codex or ChatGPT plugin, I'd be glad to list it for free. You can submit at https://pickaplugin.com/submit or just reply with the repo.

If the post ever gets an update, our Codex plugin report is free to cite too: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

Aaron, PickAPlugin
